effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your blue Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 blue Digimon.
[When Digivolving] By placing a blue level 3 Digimon card from your hand under 1 of your blue Digimon as its bottom digivolution card, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
